data_details.sampler: upstream sorted shard order, row-group order, best-fit BOS packing

notes: Corrected-BPB Karpathy baseline, pinned corpus, pre-tokenized flat token cache. New scope ID because prepare.py's digest changed. The token stream is provably identical to v2b and evaluate_bpb is byte-identical, so the only intended difference is steps completed in the 300s frame: v2b was pinned at ~277 steps / 11.3% MFU by a single producer thread re-tokenizing the corpus every run. Not interchangeable with upstream scores, with v2a/v2b, or with the plain_v2 campaign.
precision: bfloat16 autocast; float32 logits and cross-entropy

runtime_details.attention_backend: kernels 0.12.1 dynamic flash-attention lookup, pinned by lockfile digest not by image digest
runtime_details.host_note: shared multi-tenant host; observed load average >280 with 16 users. Contention is the dominant noise source and is controlled by same-GPU 20-minute banked controls, not by this field.
runtime_details.runtime_image: bare-metal host zp-nc71, no container; runtime pinned by uv.lock and driver 580.95.05

tokenizer_details.byte_accounting: token_bytes format 2: decode_single_token_bytes; special tokens count zero bytes
